business_problem: First Orion needed a better way to support caller transparency, spoof mitigation, and AI-powered scam detection because massive call volumes and siloed EMR-based data workflows made fraud detection and new AI features costly to develop and hard to govern.
solution_summary: First Orion uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support caller transparency, spoof mitigation, and AI-powered scam detection. The implementation replaced a legacy state where massive call volumes and siloed EMR-based data workflows made fraud detection and new AI features costly to develop and hard to govern. Call traffic data and scam and spoofing signals move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver caller transparency products and fraud and compliance analytics. First Orion improved caller transparency, spoof mitigation, and AI-powered scam detection with measurable results including $12.
business_outcome: First Orion improved caller transparency, spoof mitigation, and AI-powered scam detection with measurable results including $12.7M building trust in mobile communications and 5x efficiencies and new product innovations, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: From developers to architects to data scientists, we’re saving a massive amount of time now that they can focus on outcomes, collaborate on the same platform, easily access data, and use the tools to help other teams.
Team members can be independent without being siloed because Databricks has straightforward tools. Almost anyone can access and apply the insights and analytics we need to optimize communications.
